name: Tramontane Armor

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: +1 AC and you cross snow, ice, rubble and undergrowth freely; once a day its grip drags creatures to you.
text: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor, and snow, ice, rubble and undergrowth cost you no extra movement. Once per dawn you can wake its grip as a Magic action for 1 minute (another Magic action ends it). While it's awake, as a Bonus Action you choose creatures you can see within 20 feet: each makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw or has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and is pulled up to 20 feet toward you.

powers.name: Tramontane Grip
powers.text: Magic action: the armor's grip wakes for 1 minute.

powers.name: Drag Toward You
powers.text: Bonus Action while the grip is awake: chosen creatures within 20 ft make a DC 15 Strength save or are Grappled and pulled 20 ft toward you.
